name: nostr-vcard
description: Zero-knowledge, client-side encrypted vCard sharing via Nostr relays
notes: nostr-tools is self-hosted in public/vendor/nostr-tools.js (pinned, bundled via `npm run build:vendor`) — no CDN at runtime.
Add a bundler and switch imports to bare specifiers if a build step is desired later.
crypto.js and vcard.js are ported from the companion e2e-vcard-sharing project.
public/vendor/bip39-wordlist.js is the official 2048-word BIP39 English list, vendored from @scure/bip39 (MIT) — used only as a high-entropy word source for sync passphrases, not for BIP39 mnemonics.
